notes.title: Lane Hunters – Demo v0.0.5 Update Released on Steam
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a monetization system.
[*] Cars can now be unlocked with in-game currency.
[*] Earn money by performing near misses and drifting past other vehicles.
[*] Simplified the main menu for easier navigation.
[*] Cooperative (Co-op) mode is now playable.
[*] Optimized the Highway map for better performance.
[*] Temporarily removed the Drift map until a superior version is ready.
[/list]
